Natural wrists, coherent anatomy, no extra hands or fingers. One character and one package only: no duplicate packs, additional people or added logos on clothing or scenery. Tasteful, brand-safe and family-friendly. No captions, slogans, speech bubbles or watermarks; text appears only on the reference package. Continue the scene naturally to every edge. Keep only the lowest 8% visually calm for the kiosk signature, without a solid blank strip or horizontal divider. Keep the face, hands, package and feet above that area.
